title: Brasileirão round 35, Uruguay's final Clausura round, UAE Pro League
updateNote: A quiet Thursday after the international window: no top-flight men's league games in Europe (the leagues return on Friday). Seven games instead: two UAE Pro League games (Al Wasl v Hatta 13:45, Al Ain v Al Dhafra 16:25), the last round of Uruguay's Clausura at 20:30 with Peñarol one win from first place in the annual table, and two Brasileirão round-35 games at 23:30 (Vasco v Internacional, Vitória v Bragantino). Main prices are Pinnacle via OddsPapi (09:53 Warsaw); bet365 extras and player props for the Brazilian games come from KickOff. Team sheets for the UAE and Uruguayan games are pending and the kick-off-minus-40 runs fill them in. São Paulo v Fluminense (01:30) belongs to 20 Nov; the Women's Champions League and U-17 World Cup games are left off.

matches.context: Kick-off is 12:45 UTC (16:45 UAE) at Zabeel Stadium, per footballpredictions.ai (12:45 UK time) and 22bet (12:45 UTC). Round 9 per 22bet ('Matchweek 9'). Emarat Al Youm (7 Nov) calls the 7-8 Nov games Round 8 and Gulf Today calls 10-11 Sep Round 5, yet all four sides have played only seven league games, so one earlier round has not been played by these teams. Al Wasl are 6th on 13 points after seven games (W4 D1 L2, 18-8). Their last league game was a 2-1 defeat at Al Jazira on 8 Nov, after a 2-0 win at Baniyas on 16 Oct, and they beat Al Nasr 2-0 on 14 Nov. Hatta are 13th of 14 on 3 points (W1 D0 L6, 6-15). Their only league win is 1-0 against Baniyas on 5 Sep, and they lost 2-1 at home to Khorfakkan on 7 Nov and 1-0 to Al Ain in the League Cup on 14 Nov. Al Wasl are unbeaten in the last eight meetings listed (W7 D1), including 3-0 at home and 5-0 away in the 2023-24 Pro League; the sides have not met since April 2024.

They drew 0-0 at Al Wahda on 8 Nov, beat Hatta 1-0 in the League Cup on 14 Nov and won 4-1 at Al-Ittihad in the AFC Champions League Elite on 2 Nov; their only league defeat is 2-0 to Shabab Al Ahli on 17 Oct. They lost 3-1 at home to Ittihad Kalba on 7 Nov, then beat Ajman 1-0 in the League Cup on 14 Nov; their league wins are 2-1 at Hatta and 5-1 against Dubai United. Al Ain have won the last five meetings and seven of the last eight, including 5-0 at home on 10 May 2026 and 2-1 away on 8 Jan 2026.

news.text: Abdoul Karim Traoré (two yellows against Shabab Al Ahli in round 6) served his one-game ban in the 0-0 at Al Wahda on 8 Nov and is available. He is Al Ain's top league scorer with 2.
Sofiane Rahimi was injured against Shabab Al Ahli in the President's Cup (22 Oct) and was still out with no return date on 7 Nov.
Marcel Ratnik has been injured since the round 2 game against Khorfakkan and was still out with no return date on 7 Nov.

Skoko (Arabic: جورج سكوكو) got a straight red against Shabab Al Ahli in the President's Cup last 16, a two-game ban to be served in the next domestic competitions after Al Ain's cup exit. Al Ain are also in the AFC Champions League Elite (won 4-1 at Al-Ittihad on 2 Nov), so rotation is possible.
Emarat Al Youm listed no Al Dhafra absentees for round 8; Yousuf Al Marzouqi returned from a suspension for the Kalba game. No later news found.

matches.context: Kick-off is Thursday 16:30 Uruguay time (19:30 UTC) in Florida, last round of the 2026 Clausura, at the same time as Peñarol v Cerro Largo and Progreso v City Torque (Montevideo Portal). Boston River are 11th in the Clausura (W4 D3 L7, 15-18, 15 pts) and 14th in the Tabla Anual (37 pts, W10 D7 L19, 34-48); Montevideo Portal says they have nothing immediate to play for. They have lost their last three: 0-2 at Cerro Largo (25 Oct), 1-2 v City Torque (1 Nov) and 0-1 at Central Español (14 Nov), after wins at Wanderers (3-1) and v Defensor (1-0). Deportivo Maldonado are 5th in the Clausura (W6 D4 L4, 18-11, 22 pts) and 3rd in the Anual on 63 (W18 D9 L9, 54-33), three behind Peñarol and one behind City Torque: they must win and need City Torque not to win and Peñarol to lose to force an Anual final, and they are also chasing a Copa Libertadores place. Maldonado have won one of their last five (2-1 v Danubio, 24 Oct), with draws v Liverpool (1-1) and at Albion (0-0) and defeats at Nacional (2-3) and at home to Cerro (0-1, 14 Nov). Maldonado beat Boston River 2-1 at home in the Apertura on 11 May (RSSSF).

matches.context: Kick-off is Thursday 16:30 Uruguay time (19:30 UTC), the last round of the 2026 Clausura, played at the same time as Progreso v City Torque and Boston River v Deportivo Maldonado (Montevideo Portal, El Observador). Peñarol (Diego Aguirre) top the Tabla Anual on 66 points (W19 D10 L7, 53-29 in 36, after a one-point deduction), two ahead of City Torque (64) and three ahead of Deportivo Maldonado (63); a win clinches first place and a place in the final against the winner of Racing v Liverpool. They are 4th in the Clausura (W6 D6 L2, 18-10, 23 pts) but have not won since beating Racing 1-0 on 4 Oct: in the league since then L 0-1 at Liverpool and draws with Progreso (1-1), Juventud (0-0), Wanderers (1-1) and Defensor Sporting (1-1, conceded in the last play on 15 Nov), plus a 2-0 Copa AUF Uruguay defeat to City Torque on 27 Oct that knocked them out. Cerro Largo (Bruno Silva) are 15th in the Clausura with one win in 14 (W1 D7 L6, 12-19; the win was 2-0 v Boston River on 25 Oct), 13th in the Anual (38 pts), and 12th in the relegation averages on 87, one point above Wanderers and Cerro (85): a defeat would send them down on Friday if both Cerro (v Nacional) and Wanderers (at Liverpool) win. Peñarol beat Cerro Largo 3-2 away in the Apertura (11 May) and 3-0 at home in the Intermedio (1 Aug); Cerro Largo won 2-0 at the Campeón del Siglo in 2025.

news.text: Goalkeeper Washington Aguerre and midfielder Eric Remedi (yellow-card bans) and winger Luis Angulo (sent off against Wanderers) have served their suspensions and are available.

Leonel Jaime returns to the starting XI (he was on the bench against Defensor). Aguirre was weighing a double nine with Matías Arezo and Abel Hernández, but a single striker is considered more likely.
Nahuel Herrera, who missed the Defensor game late with a foot problem after about a month out, is in the squad but likely to start on the bench.
Franco Romero, Diego Laxalt and Gonzalo Gelini are over their injuries but have not been picked lately for lack of match fitness.

Peñarol's fans are back at the Campeón del Siglo now the four-game sanction for incidents at the clásico has ended. A win secures first place in the Tabla Anual and a final against the Racing-Liverpool winner.
news.src: El Observador (16 and 18 Nov); Montevideo Portal (17 Nov)

matches.context: Kick-off is 19:30 Brasília time (22:30 UTC) at São Januário, per Terra and Zonamista (both 18 Nov); KickOff and statz.ai both give 22:30 UK time. Vasco (Pedro Emanuel, in charge since July) are 11th on 44 points after 34 games (W12 D8 L14, 45-50) and have won their last two league games, 3-1 at Athletico-PR and 2-0 at Chapecoense on 14 Nov, after a 4-1 home defeat to Flamengo; a win would take them closer to the top eight and a possible Libertadores place. Internacional (Eduardo Baptista) are 16th on 38 points (W9 D11 L14, 38-42), one point above the relegation zone, level with Vitória and one ahead of Corinthians and Grêmio; Zonamista cites UFMG's 36.8% relegation chance for them. Inter beat Coritiba 1-0 on 3 Nov with a stoppage-time Alerrandro penalty, but their last three away league games were a 1-1 at Grêmio and defeats at Mirassol (2-0) and Fluminense (2-1), and they have scored 16 and conceded 25 in 17 away games (statz.ai). Inter won the reverse fixture 4-1 on 16 May, while Vasco won 5-1 at São Januário in November 2025. Inter are without Gabriel Maripán (suspended) and Thiago Maia, while Vasco expect Thiago Mendes and Santiago Sosa back from minor problems.

news.text: Thiago Mendes (back pain) and Santiago Sosa (left adductor, fatigue) missed the 2-0 win at Chapecoense but trained normally on 16 Nov and are expected to start in midfield.
Nuno Moreira (right adductor) is back in pitch work, but his availability depends on the club's assessment. Sports Mole (16 Nov) listed him out.
Cauan Barros and Carlos Cuesta are injured. Tchê Tchê also missed the Chapecoense game on fitness grounds.
Robert Renan came off after 60 minutes at Chapecoense with physical discomfort (Sports Mole), but he is in every Brazilian predicted XI.
Paulo Henrique is expected to start at right-back ahead of Puma Rodríguez (5 goals, 8 assists, 63 shots this season, statz.ai).
Vasco are 11th on 44 points and want to close in on the top eight and keep a Libertadores place in reach.
Gabriel Maripán is suspended after a stoppage-time red card received on the bench against Coritiba.
Thiago Maia is out for physical reasons the club has not disclosed (Terra); Zonamista says his status is still unresolved. Ronaldo is the likely replacement.
Alan Patrick (6 goals, statz.ai) has returned to training and is in both Brazilian predicted XIs. Sports Mole (16 Nov) had listed him out with a muscle injury.
Antonio Sanabria (calf), Kayky (ankle), goalkeeper Sergio Rochet (back), Matheus Cunha (elbow), Anthoni (knee) and Benjamin Arhin (hamstring) are injured; Kauan Jesus keeps goal.

Inter are 16th on 38 points, one point above the relegation zone, with Vitória on 38 and Corinthians and Grêmio on 37. UFMG put their relegation chance at 36.8%. Their next two games are at home to Vitória (23 Nov) and Bragantino (29 Nov).

matches.context: Kick-off is 19:30 Brasília time (22:30 UTC) at the Barradão, per Terra and Lance; KickOff and statz.ai both give 22:30 UK time, and the CBF lists the game as Série A Jogo 349. Vitória are 15th on 38 points after 34 games (35-51), one point above the relegation zone, where Corinthians and Grêmio sit on 37. They have taken two points from their last five league games (L 2-1 at São Paulo, D 1-1 at Corinthians, D 1-1 v Athletico-PR, L 2-0 at Coritiba, L 3-0 v Fluminense), and Jair Ventura was sacked after the Fluminense defeat, so Rafael Lacerda (ex-Chapecoense) takes his first game. Home form is their strength: W10 D2 L5 in 17 home league games (Sports Mole), scoring 23 and conceding 16 at home against 12-35 away (statz.ai). Bragantino (Vagner Mancini) are 8th on 47 points (44-39) and chasing a 2027 Libertadores preliminary place; they beat Chapecoense 3-0 and Santos 2-1 at home in their last two, but have won only 4 of 17 away league games (W4 D5 L8, 15-21) and have not won away in six months (Terra). Bragantino won the reverse fixture 2-0 on 17 May and 4-0 in December 2025, while Vitória won the two meetings before that 1-0 at home; Bragantino are without the suspended Lucas Barbosa, and Vitória cannot use Bragantino loanees Luan Cândido and Nacho Laquintana.

news.text: New coach: Jair Ventura was sacked after the 3-0 home defeat to Fluminense, and Rafael Lacerda (ex-Chapecoense) takes charge for the first time.

Luan Cândido and Nacho Laquintana are on loan from Bragantino and their loan terms keep them out of this game. The same clause ruled out Luan Cândido and Nathan Mendes for the reverse fixture in May (A Tarde).
Nathan Mendes, Fabiano Souza, Edu, Camutanga and Riccieli are injured, and Dudu is also unavailable.
Ramon (thigh; 29 fouls and 36 tackles in 20 games, statz.ai) has recovered and may be in the squad, per Lance. Terra and Sports Mole still list him injured.
Centre-back Emanuel Brítez is back from suspension.
Vitória are 15th on 38 points, one point above the relegation zone (Corinthians 17th and Grêmio on 37), with no win in five league games; a defeat could drop them into the Z4.
Lucas Barbosa is suspended after his third yellow card. He leads Bragantino with 99 shots and 7 goals in 39 games (statz.ai) and 7 Série A goals (FotMob).
Rodriguinho and Davi Gomes are with the medical department.
José Hurtado is a doubt with a thigh problem.
Isidro Pitta (9 goals and 78 shots in 40 games, statz.ai; 5 Série A goals, FotMob) is in none of the predicted XIs, and none of the previews says why.
Bragantino are 8th on 47 points and chasing the G6 and a 2027 Libertadores preliminary place. They have not won away from home in six months.
